title: Router control from the CLI: pause, resume and capped sweep, admin-only and audited
description: Narrow admin-only mutations for enabling and disabling a monitor and running a capped route sweep, recorded with who did it. Replaces the set_enabled and enable_one scripts. Mutations follow the CLI convention of writing unless --dry-run. Needs Ryan's review of the permission scope before deploy.
